data.title: 提丰 · 散步时把松果留给你
data.description: 公园散步途中，提丰停在松树旁，摊开手心把一枚漂亮的松果给你看。她侧身回望同行的你，长外套的灰白衣摆落在小径旁，脸上带着不太张扬的得意。
data.action: 摊开手心展示松果，侧身回望镜头
data.mood: 安静的分享欲与小小得意
data.lighting: 树冠间斑驳的午后阳光
data.promptProse: Typhon pauses by a pine tree and turns sideways toward her walking companion, displaying a pretty pinecone on her open palm. Her gray-and-white hunter coat hangs beside the park path in the eye-level cowboy view. Overlapping trunks lead down the walkway behind. Afternoon light breaks through the canopy across her sleeve and the cone's scales, leaving cool shade beneath the broad coat hem.
